answer: Each agent runs a signed kernel module that reads a hardware-rooted entropy beacon; the network issues a prism challenge of k random spectral hashes of that beacon, forcing a distinct beacon value per identity and making sybil creation cost linear in physical devices. Responses are appended to a grove of immutable logs that cross-check for duplicate beacon fingerprints, and any collision triggers an automatic slash of the offending stake. The cost scales with each unique hardware module, deterring mass-registration.
